'''Thesum-bark syrup''' was a type of [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] from the [[planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] that was often given as a wedding present by the native [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]]. The syrup was [[Nadia Grell]]'s favorite, though non-Sarkhai thought it tasted like medicine.
